primary.title: Nifty 50 target: Will it hit 25,000 this year? Market experts weigh in on what could drive the recovery
primary.summary: Achieving the 25,000 mark on the Nifty requires positive global cues, stronger corporate earnings, and manageable crude oil prices. The index, down 11% year-to-date, needs to overcome current hurdles related to external economic pressures.
